corrections_to_prior.wall2_mechanism: NOT 'unversioned dlsym'. brk_open scandir()s /system/usr/icu, atoi()s the icudt<N> version (>=44), %s%s-builds a SUFFIXED symbol. 61b /system/usr/icu = icudt74l (ICU 74) -> tttext wants ubrk_open_74; our Android ICU exports only _72 -> dlsym null -> crash. A VERSION MISMATCH. (evidence/brk_open-versiondetect.txt)
corrections_to_prior.wall1_fix_location: NOT app_native_loader.c/libapp_native_loader.so (forwards only; host op ABI v1 has no app_shared_sonames). The app ns visible libs are set in the stock host westlake_stock_host_main.c StockCreateConfiguredNamespaces: dlns_inherit(app, bridge, bridge_shared_sonames). (evidence/appns-inherit-mechanism.txt)

appns_mechanism: app ns = dlns_create2(LOCAL_NS_PREFERED) + separated + permitted(app_permitted_paths) + dlns_inherit(app, bridge, bridge_shared_sonames). bridge = dlns_create2(CREATE_INHERIT_DEFAULT) + separated + permitted(/system/android/lib64) + allowed_libs(bridge_shared_sonames). The app sees from the bridge exactly bridge_shared_sonames; the bridge resolves them from DEFAULT (platform) + /system/android/lib64. So missing public sonames = ENOENT; adding them to the inherit SHARES the single platform/bridge copy (no double copy).

icu_sandbox.system_usr_icu: OHOS base app sandbox mount (OH mounts /system/usr into every app); our config does not remove it. Visible in the toutiao sandbox (proven: scandir succeeded, picked 74).
icu_sandbox.our_android_icu: appspawn_x.cfg ICU_DATA=/system/android/etc/icu (icudt72l); payload ships ICU-72 libicuuc/libicui18n
icu_sandbox.who_reads_system_usr_icu: our Android payload libs: NONE (open-site scan). OH platform libs (/system/lib64, not scannable locally) use it (ICU 74) -> any remap MUST be per-app, never global.

wall2_fix.a_recommended: per-app sandbox bind-mount an icudt72l dir over /system/usr/icu for the Android app domain only -> tttext finds 72 -> _72 matches. Blast radius minimal, per-app, data-dir only. Double-copy: none.
wall2_fix.b_fallback: add _74 alias exports to Android libicuuc/libicui18n (alias -> _72 impls). One lib, no second copy; safe for the stable C ABI tttext uses; touches a shared artifact.
wall2_fix.c: bump Android ICU to 74 (biggest blast radius, re-binds runtime _72 cohort) or repoint tttext (needs apk edit -- rejected). Not minimal.

wall1_fix.change: augment the app<->bridge dlns_inherit list with libicui18n.so:libicuuc.so:libGLESv2.so:libGLESv3.so:libvulkan.so:libjnigraphics.so (AOSP public.libraries.android.txt). Bridge allowed_libs unchanged.
wall1_fix.excluded: libandroidio.so, libjavacore.so (not public; ART-internal; exposing risks double-loading ART internals)
wall1_fix.double_copy: none -- dlns_inherit shares the bridge's copy, bridge inherits the single DEFAULT-ns platform copy. The wrong fix (app_search_paths += /system/android/lib64) WOULD double-copy ICU.
wall1_fix.byte_repro_target_correction: dispatch said reproduce libapp_native_loader.so (N10b); that lib holds no soname list. Correct target = the stock-host artifact (stock_child_plugin/appspawn-x host providing StockCreateConfiguredNamespaces).
